title: Great style and beautifully made!
text: Great style and beautifully made!. Beautiful bamboo bath mat! Works perfectly in any space and it's so modern looking!

product_metadata.title: Bamboo Wooden Bath Floor Mat for Luxury Shower - Non-Slip Bathroom Waterproof Carpet for Indoor or Outdoor Use (31.3 x 18.1 x 1.5 Inches)
features: ☑EXCELLENT SLIP RESISTANCE : Soft non-slip rubber feet under the bamboo shower mat will not only ensure your safety but also protect your floor away from scratches

☑ECO-FRIENDLY MATERIAL: Bamboo has the characteristics of renewability and shorter growing duration which are accordant with the environmental protection concepts, but as sturdy as those synthetic material

☑WATERPROOF PERFORMANCE : The bamboo mat with three-layer waterproof coating has slatted surface which can conduce to drainage; unlike those cloth mats on the market which will absorb a lot of water and get moldy easily

☑EASY to CLEAN: The smooth surface makes the mat stain resistant and can keep dirt from staying on the mat, so it’s easy to keep clean; just use a dry cloth to wipe it after daily use; completely free your worries of cleaning problems

☑VERSATILITY: The floor mat is ideal for bathroom, kitchen, entryway, hallways, office, spa or sauna, the stylish look also makes it a modern home decor; as for the outdoor use, such as swimming pool, outdoor shower room and you can even take it when you go to the beach,etc
